description: Read billing and provenance for a finished job. Does not run capabilities or spend money. Use after terminal success; use hydracept_job_status while still running. Hosted MCP accepts job_id only. Requires bearer key. No charge. Returns: HydraceptReceipt JSON for a terminal job. Errors: WORKSPACE_KEY_REQUIRED, NOT_FOUND when job or receipt is missing.

job_id.description: Job or execution id for GET /v1/jobs/{jobId}/receipt. Required on hosted MCP.
job_id.title: Job Id

name: hydracept_get_receipt
title: Read a receipt
